newsitem.title: USA: U.S. orange juice exports hit record value/volume.
newsitem.headline: U.S. orange juice exports hit record value/volume.

text.p: U.S. exports of orange juice in marketing year 1995/96 (December-November) reached a record 92,127 tonnes, 10 percent above the record of the previous year, the Agriculture Department reported Monday.
Export value also set a record fo $283 million, up 4 percent from the previous year.
The European Union, Canada and Japan are the major markets for U.S. orange juice exports, accounting for 43, 27 and 12 percent respectively of U.S. sales in 1995/96.
The EU has become a growth market for U.S. orange juice: shipments reached a record 39,753 tonnes in 1995/96, up 11 percent from the previous year and more than double the level of 5 years ago.
U.S. exports to Japan recovered this past season, and sales to Canada have remained strong.
The Agriculture Department releases its current estimates on this year's U.S. orange crop production this Wednesday.

The impacts of a severe frost in Florida on January 19 and 20 will be reflected in that estimate. A USDA official said it appeared from reports from the affected areas that the frost was not as bad as it was first thought.
